name: com.tencent.timpush.meizu.TIMMeiZuService
description: Tencent Cloud IM (TIM)'s Meizu push provider starts with the app and registers its connector. When requested, it registers the app with Meizu Push using the configured credentials.
disableEffect: Meizu push registration stops, and a later registration-status callback from the still-enabled Meizu receiver can fail because this provider is missing.
